# CA Shreeya Mundade

> Shreeya Mundade is a Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 7+ years of experience in bookkeeping, month-end close, financial reporting and virtual CFO work for eCommerce, D2C, retail and service businesses. She is an Engagement Lead at Renocrew Solutions and works with clients on Upwork (Top Rated Plus, 100% Job Success). Based in Mumbai, India; works remotely with clients worldwide.

Website: https://www.shreeyamundade.com/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shreeyamundade/
Upwork: https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/shreeyamundade
Book a call: https://www.shreeyamundade.com/#contact

## Services

- Bookkeeping & Month-End Close: Full-cycle bookkeeping, AR and AP, bank and credit card reconciliations, and a standard month-end close checklist.
- Catch-Up, Cleanup & Migrations: Catch-up bookkeeping, system cleanups and migrations across QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho and NetSuite.
- eCommerce & Payment Reconciliation: Amazon, Shopify and TikTok Shop sales through A2X and MyWorks, and Stripe, PayPal, Square, Klarna, Afterpay, Adyen and Payoneer payouts reconciled.
- Virtual CFO: Financial oversight and strategy for D2C and retail brands, with cost restructuring and vendor negotiations that have cut client operating costs by 20 to 30%.
- Budgeting & Forecasting: Budgets, 13-week cash flow forecasts and financial models that tie marketing spend, inventory and operations to growth targets.
- MIS & Dashboards: Monthly MIS packs and interactive dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin, ad ROI and contribution profitability.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Which accounting software do you work in?

QuickBooks Online (ProAdvisor since 2022), Xero (certified in 2024), Oracle NetSuite, Sage Intacct and Zoho Books, as well as Odoo, AppFolio and Yardi. I connect them to A2X, MyWorks, Bill.com and Dext, and build reporting in Excel, Power Query, Google Sheets and Looker Studio.

### Do you work with Shopify and Amazon sellers?

Yes, eCommerce is my main focus. I bring Amazon, Shopify and TikTok Shop sales in through A2X and MyWorks, and reconcile Stripe, PayPal, Square, Klarna, Afterpay, Adyen and Payoneer payouts to the bank.

### Can you catch up or clean up books that are months behind?

Yes. Catch-up bookkeeping and cleanups are a large part of my work, and I migrate clients between QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho and NetSuite with zero data loss.

### What does your virtual CFO support include?

Budgets, 13-week cash flow forecasts, financial models, monthly MIS packs and KPI dashboards tracking revenue, gross margin, ad ROI and contribution profitability, plus cost reviews. For past clients, cost restructuring and vendor negotiations cut operating costs by 20 to 30%.

### Where are you based, and do you work remotely?

I'm based in Mumbai, India (IST, UTC+5:30) and work remotely with clients worldwide, over video calls and inside your own accounting systems.

### How do we get started?

Book a free call from this page and walk me through your books and what isn't working. We'll agree on the next step on the call.

## Blog

Plain-English accounting explainers by Shreeya:

- [Why your Shopify payout doesn't match your sales](https://www.shreeyamundade.com/blog/why-shopify-payout-doesnt-match-sales): Shopify and Amazon payouts never match sales because fees, refunds and reserves come out first. Five steps, from a clearing account to A2X, make every dollar tie out.
- [Why your Sage Intacct reports disagree](https://www.shreeyamundade.com/blog/why-sage-intacct-reports-disagree): When Sage Intacct reports tell different stories, the cause is usually dimension sprawl: missing departments, duplicate locations and untagged lines. Five steps fix it for good.
- [The month-end close, step by step](https://www.shreeyamundade.com/blog/month-end-close-in-six-levels): Catching up on the books once a year, at tax time, isn't bookkeeping. A proper month-end close has six steps: bank feeds, categorizing, reconciliations, accruals, amortization and P&L analysis.
